decisions.reason: Although it is distant from the established offer and only mentioned on the website, the multi-model product line represents significant sunk investment, so escalation of commitment makes a drop unlikely.

As a highly visible, multi-model product line that builds on the established offer and serves core industrial users, it has strong investment, commitment, and centrality, making a drop very unlikely.
